entities.name: Abdullah ibn Hudhafah as-Sahmi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abd Allah ibn Hudhafa al-Sahmi was a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. He is best known in Islamic tradition for his role as the courier of a letter from Muhammad to Khosrow II, the King of Persia, and for his imprisonment and torture by Heraclius, the Byzantine Emperor.
